title: Otori Emu — Happy Birthday!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line:
Come on, Shosuke, you too.
Quit being so bashful and celebrate your little sister's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Huh? We aren't kids anymore. Also, who are you calling bashful?

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Mom and Dad even said they'd be coming home early today, which means you get to have a birthday party tonight with all of us there.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, I plan to be there.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! I'll do my best to get home early!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Yes, we'd appreciate that.
Also, Emu, there's something we'll need you to do.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You'll need to look at this piece of paper.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: A piece of paper? It looks kinda like a letter...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: I received that from someone you may or may not know. We don't know what's going on or what's written, but they said you'll understand once you read it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, I just have to read it? Then, I'll open it now!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Honestly, dragging us into something so...

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it's nice. It shows how close they all are.

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: So, Emu, what does it say?

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line:
“Go to your place of education!
The next path for you to take shall be revealed there!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Place of education...? So, it's telling me to go to school?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Okay, Private Emu.
Your mission is to go to school as ordered.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Roger!
Private Emu will head out immediately!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: And don't cross any streets without looking first!

rows.Speaker: Hinata
rows.Line: Hehe. I hope this turns into a wonderful day for Emu.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I wonder what my next path is?
I can't wait to find out what that piece of paper meant♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Morning☆
Wait, what are you all doing in front of our classroom?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. We were waiting for you, silly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here, Emu. This is from us.
We really hope you like it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You got me a present?!
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We discussed at length what to get you and chose very carefully, so I'm sure you're going to enjoy it.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, what's inside?!
I can't wait to open it☆

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's about time we gave her the thing. Saki, if you will.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Private Emu, congratulations on making it this far! Here is your next assignment!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's like the one Keisuke gave me!
Oh, Saki, did you also get it from “someone I may or may not know”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup♪ They said, “Hand this to Emu when you're at school!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! You kinda sounded like Tsukasa just now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Oh, um... Y-Yeah, I guess...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: S-Saki was given this paper by a man, but there's no guarantee that your brother received his from the same person, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, you're giving away too much...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I see...
That means there's more than one culprit at work, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: F-For now, why don't you see what's written?

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Congratulations on making it this far. For your second assignment, you are to find the idols after school who hone their craft under the blue sky.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I'm supposed to find them after school! I can't wait to find out what it means!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Sounds like you get to have quite a bit of fun after school.

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Happy birthday, Emu!
Happy birthday, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you all so much♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is for you, Otori. From us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh wow! You all got me a present too, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. Because you're my dear friend.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Haruka, Minori, thank you so much!
You too, Airi, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome! Not only are you my adorable, little junior...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're still members of the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Emu, this is also for you!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hey, another assignment!
Who did you guys get this from?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I have a feeling that things will be more fun if we keep that secret until the end, no?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Agreed. You'll have to deduce that for yourself, Otori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly!
Anyway, why don't you see what's written?

rows.Speaker: Written Assignment
rows.Line: “Congratulations on making it this far. For your third assignment, you are to go to the smile-filled wonderland where those who watch over our thoughts and feelings await.”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Emu, do you know where your next destination is?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ Thanks for the present and relaying my assignment to me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's your special day, so please have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
You startled me...
Otori, you know you're not supposed to run in the corridors.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I-I-I-I'm so sorry...!
There's somewhere I really have to go and...!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. Isn't it your birthday today? Did you make plans to meet with someone?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? Y-Yes!
But how did you know it's my...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: We had a student council meeting during lunch and I just happened to hear Hoshino mention it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, I'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
(Her eyes weren't smiling at all...
But still, she wished me a happy birthday!)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Now, I've gotta go see Miku and the others♪
